description: Global Peace Index score and rank for ONE country — a country peacefulness measure (societal safety, ongoing conflict, and militarisation indicators rolled into one score; LOWER = more peaceful). Published annually by the Institute for Economics & Peace. PREFER for "how peaceful is <country>", "<country> global peace index", "peace ranking for <country>", or as background context on a country before/alongside news-event data (complements gdelt). Pass a country name (e.g. "Iceland", "Russia", "United States" — common aliases like "USA"/"DRC" are accepted).
name: gpi_country_score
title: Gpi Country Score
